podcast.body: An instrumental album released on June 26, 2007, an idea the band had considered since their "Check Your Head" days in 1991-1992. Although it didn't sell very well, it won a Grammy for Best Instrumental Album and was intended as a statement about the status of hip-hop music. "It didn't sell very well, but it did win a Grammy for Best Instrumental Album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Released on June 26, 2007, this "straight instrumental record" was an idea the band had considered since the early 1990s but dismissed as "non-commercial and frankly rather crazy" at the time. It was intended as a "statement about the status of hip-hop music." "It didn't sell very well, but it did win a Grammy for Best Instrumental Album."
